ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential fraud in Minnesota Medicaid funding, including the $3.1 billion at risk.
questions: What is the extent of the fraud in Minnesota Medicaid funding?
How can the state prevent similar fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and waste in the Medicaid program, and could lead to changes in how the program is administered.
